falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 4.0% above the verdict-session close within 14 days, and VIX closes at or below 15 on three consecutive sessions
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The HOLD/UNKNOWN call missed a completed bottom and risk-on resolution; the Aug-2024-bottom analog should have been a long, not a hold.

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 5.0% below the verdict-session close within 14 days, and VIX closes at or above 28 on the same session
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The base failed. Similarity to bottom_2024_aug does not describe a holdable bottom; the correct call was risk-off, not UNKNOWN/HOLD.

falsification_conditions.condition: Pattern-match similarity to bottom_2024_aug falls below 45%, or the blowoff score prints at or above 65, within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The features supporting the current UNKNOWN/HOLD verdict no longer hold, so that call is invalidated whether the regime resolved into a blowoff or a non-bottom pattern.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
